title: Last Light Courier
tagline: A little light. A long way home.
pitch: Carry the last lantern through a darkening forest, delivering supplies and relighting camps before your flame burns out.
hook: Your light is both your compass and your countdown. Taking a shortcut saves time, but the safe route has fuel.
loop: Pick up a delivery and fill your lantern.
Choose a route through the forest and manage your fuel.
Reach a camp, relight its beacon, and unlock the next delivery.
mvp: One compact woodland loop, three camps, three deliveries, a fuel meter, and one win/lose screen. Use static camps instead of animated NPCs.
custom: Lantern model and light, parcel, camp markers, interaction prompts, fuel logic, route layout, and sound. The third-person courier in the concept art is illustrative; the prototype uses a first-person camera.
lesson: Player movement, raycast interaction, lighting, UI signals, and a simple game state.
risk: Night lighting must keep the path readable on small screens. Start with a short route and soft ambient light.
video: From greybox forest to glowing delivery route: a clear before-and-after reveal, with a final low-fuel run.
alt: A lantern-carrying courier follows an amber-lit trail through a teal low-poly forest.

title: Orbit Salvage
tagline: One battery. A whole base to wake up.
pitch: Pilot a repair drone around a silent moon base, moving scarce power cells between machines to bring the rescue beacon online.
hook: There is never enough power for everything at once. The puzzle is deciding what can switch off so something else can turn on.
loop: Inspect a broken section of the base.
Carry a cell, power a machine, and open a new route.
Reclaim cells and reroute power until the beacon activates.
mvp: One exterior base split into three puzzle areas, two movable cells, three machine types, and a final beacon. Hand-author every puzzle.
custom: A primitive drone, cell props, cable visuals, power-state materials, puzzle logic, interactions, and audio. Build the ground from simple meshes.
lesson: Object pickup, reusable interactables, state machines, puzzle dependencies, and emissive materials.
risk: Prevent softlocks by allowing cells to be recovered or adding a reset button for the current puzzle.
video: A dead base lights up piece by piece. Show the power graph on screen as the puzzle is solved.
alt: An orange repair drone moves a glowing power cell between modules on a small lunar base.

title: Midnight Groundskeeper
tagline: Even ghosts like a tidy garden.
pitch: Spend the night tending a tiny haunted cemetery: sweep paths, water spectral flowers, and fulfill gentle requests from its ghostly residents.
hook: Every little chore makes the graveyard warmer and friendlier, turning a spooky place into somewhere you want to stay.
loop: Use the right tool to clean, water, or decorate.
Earn a glowing flower and bring color back to the cemetery.
mvp: One enclosed cemetery, two tools, six chore spots, three ghost requests, and a single-night completion screen. Use progress bars for cleaning.
custom: Simple sheet ghosts, broom and watering can, flower effects, task UI, tool animations, and request logic. Ghosts can be mesh primitives with a bobbing animation.
lesson: Interaction targets, tool switching, progress feedback, task tracking, and environmental storytelling.
risk: Chores need satisfying feedback. Build one complete cleaning interaction before adding more tasks.
video: A spooky-to-cozy transformation with an immediate visual payoff, ideal for a compact devlog.
alt: Friendly sheet ghosts float between candlelit pumpkins and headstones in a violet cemetery.

title: Pocket Post
pitch: Zip a tiny delivery car through a toy-sized town, chaining parcel drops into one perfect route before the shift ends.
hook: Speed helps, but a clever route wins. String deliveries together to keep your combo alive.
loop: Collect a batch of parcels from the depot.
Choose a delivery order and drive to marked drop points.
Chain quick deliveries, bank a score, and retry for a better route.
mvp: One car, one small loop of streets, five delivery points, a 90-second timer, and a score screen. Start with stationary scenery and no traffic AI.
custom: Arcade car controller, chase camera, parcel and mailbox props, delivery zones, combo UI, road layout, and sound. Recolor a pack car to create the courier vehicle.
lesson: Movement and steering, camera smoothing, trigger zones, timers, scoring, and reset flow.
risk: Vehicle handling takes tuning. Use a simple arcade body with grounded movement before attempting realistic suspension.
video: An instantly readable challenge: can you deliver all five parcels in 90 seconds? Show the route and final combo.
alt: A mustard yellow parcel car drifts around a sunny pastel town corner.

title: Cloudline
tagline: Miss a jump. Find your flow.
pitch: Leap across floating islands and ride moving platforms, collecting wind rings on a short skyward course built for satisfying retries.
hook: An easy route gets you home; a daring route collects every ring. Master the same small level instead of exploring a huge world.
loop: Read the next island and time a jump.
Ride platforms, collect rings, and reach a checkpoint.
Finish the course, then retry for fewer falls and a faster time.
mvp: One course with 12 islands, one moving-platform type, two checkpoints, ten rings, and a finish timer. Use the pack's animated character for the first build.
custom: Jump controller, checkpoint system, moving-platform logic, floating-island composition, ring pickups, and UI. The orange robot in the concept art is an optional custom skin, not an included model.
lesson: Character movement, jump forgiveness, moving platforms, camera collision, checkpoints, and collectibles.
risk: Camera and jump feel are the main work. Tune a three-platform greybox before dressing the entire course.
video: Turn three grey cubes into a sky-island course, then finish with a clean no-fall run.
alt: A tiny orange robot leaps across grassy floating islands in a pastel cloud-filled sky.
